offering_description.value: Sells CLEAR Plus, a paid membership that uses biometric identity verification to speed travelers through airport security checkpoints, and sells identity verification services to airlines, venues and other organizations. Members enroll once at kiosks or online, and partners and government agencies use the same verification platform.

primary_products.value: biometric enrollment kiosks; expedited security membership; identity verification software

primary_services.value: identity verification services; venue entry verification; fraud prevention services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual travelers and consumers who buy memberships; B2B: airlines, airports, stadiums, healthcare providers and employers; B2G: government agencies using identity verification

end_markets.value: travel; sports and entertainment; healthcare; government; financial services

revenue_model.value: subscription: individual members pay recurring membership fees; service fees: enterprise fees for identity verification and enrollment services; transaction or usage fees: per-verification fees charged to partner organizations
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: verifies identity for travelers and venue guests, sold to members and partners; software / platform: biometric identity platform licensed to airports, venues and businesses

geography_served.value: US national: airports, stadiums and venues across the United States

specialization.value: niche specialist: biometric identity verification for travel, venues and enterprises

distribution_channels.value: own locations: enrollment centers at airports and venues; online: online sign-up and membership management; partners / resellers: airline, stadium and corporate partner programs; direct sales: enterprise sales to employers and organizations
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: biometric data privacy laws and TSA checkpoint security program rules
